newsitem.title: IRAN: Force 4.8 quake hits northern Iran city.
newsitem.headline: Force 4.8 quake hits northern Iran city.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.8 on the Richter scale hit a northern Iranian city on Sunday, but there was no immediate word on casualties or damage, the official news agency IRNA said.
IRNA said the quake hit the city of Roudbar in the northern Gilan province at 01.00 a.m. (2030 GMT on Saturday).
"No report has yet been received on possible damage inflicted by the tremor," it added.
Earthquakes hit Iran regulary. The worst recorded one, measuring 7.3 on the Richter scale, killed 35,000 people in Gilan and neighbouring Zanjan province in 1990.

Earthquakes of force four or more can cause heavy damage in a populated area. Last month a force 7.1 quake devastated nearly 170 villages in the east of the country, killing at least 1,568 people and displacing 50,000.
